verdict.rationale: Pricing terms are a fair question for a subscription SaaS like Jira, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack does not document seat minimums, annual billing commitments, or how plan terms are disclosed before purchase. The only pricing-related item, a free start with no credit card, says nothing about seat or billing-commitment requirements.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
